critique: The flocking algorithm beautifully subverts expectations by organically routing the geometric, hard-edged birds around the central void, creating a living cyber-nature system that complements the Southwest-inspired woven canvas bands. However, relying on external image files (`portrait.png`, `guineapig.png`) breaks the artwork's self-contained generative ecosystem; synthesizing these subjects procedurally via Canvas or SVG would unify the aesthetic and eliminate the risk of broken imagery.
